title: Bexar County's Proposition B (November 4, 2025) in five groups of precincts holding equal numbers of households, by estimated median household income
note: Each precinct's households and median household income are estimated from the Census block groups it overlaps, by area (ACS 2020-2024). Precincts are ranked by that income and cut into five groups with equal households; fifth 1 has the lowest incomes. turnout is votes on the proposition per registered voter.
method: select fifth, count(*) as precincts, sum(yes_votes) as yes_votes, sum(no_votes) as no_votes, sum(yes_votes + no_votes) as votes, sum(yes_votes) / sum(yes_votes + no_votes) as yes_share, sum(yes_votes + no_votes) / (select sum(yes_votes + no_votes) from prop_b_fifths) as vote_share, sum(yes_votes + no_votes) / sum(registered) as turnout, sum(households_est) as households, min(median_income_est) as income_min, max(median_income_est) as income_max from prop_b_fifths group by fifth order by fifth
